errors.text_span: Стълбовете за I трим. 2020 са визуално по-ниски от тези за II трим. 2020 в повечето случаи
errors.evidence: This statement is visually incorrect. The bars for Q1 2020 (less negative values) are visually higher on the chart than the bars for Q2 2020, which represent more negative values and thus extend further down.

errors.text_span: най-високата стойност за I трим. 2020 е около -10
errors.evidence: The highest value for Q1 2020 corresponds to Turkey (Турция) and is approximately +0.5, not -10.
The lowest value in the entire chart is for the United Kingdom (Обед. кралство) in Q2 2020, which is approximately -21. The value -24 does not correspond to any bar.
